A '''Solarbenite''' was a type of extremely valuable gemstone.<ref name="JT">''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]''</ref> 

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] had a container full of solarbenite stored inside [[Catalog Nineteen]], one of the many catalogs in the Empire's storehouse.<ref name="JT" />
